propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) lacks concrete pinned backend interface specification, blocking Phase 2 implementation story decomposition and plan-review (S2–S5)

Rebar's local ticket model must be canonical; adapters translate vendor⇄local via existing mappers (outbound_fields.py, inbound_fields.py/inbound_translate.py); no separate CanonicalTicket or parallel schema

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) plus opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be unified behind one Backend facade
New RemoteRef type (vendor, instance, remote_id) replaces hardcoded 'jira' literal in apply_inbound_records.py and bare jira_key throughout the reconciler
Three leak-fixes must be integrated: ADF-sizing out of differ, lossy-status/parent rules into Jira adapter, duplicated value-maps/link-constants single-sourced
§(d) revision must update Status line and Decision/Consequences sections to reference epic bbf1 and scope first real second backend (GitHub adapter) to epic be74
